name: Elemental Live L900-series encoder appliance
source: AWS Elemental Live L900 announcement (AWS Media blog)
notes: 1RU server chassis (L900, L901, L910, L920, L940, L980; -U models add uncompressed ST 2110). Needs 31.85 in rack depth (L900/L901: 21.04 in). SDI I/O on AJA PCIe cards, 10/25/40/100G networking on NVIDIA ConnectX-6 QSFP28. DC kits for L910 and up. Check: SDI count per SKU, management ports and PSUs (AWS publishes these per SKU on request).
